# Draft:My Talking Tom 2 - mobile game

My Talking Tom 2 is a free-to-play pet simulation video game developed and published by Outfit7 for mobile devices. It is the sequel to My Talking Tom (2013) and part of the Talking Tom & Friends franchise. In addition to the caretaking gameplay of the original game, the sequel adds new features such as pets, toys, and an airplane. The game was soft launched in September 2018, before receiving a full release on Android and iOS on November 6, 2018. It has received generally favorable reviews from users and has been downloaded over a billion times.
Gameplay
My Talking Tom 2 is a pet simulator game. It continues the gameplay of its predecessor; a baby version of Talking Tom arrives at a house, and the player must take care of him by fulfilling his daily needs, such as feeding, bathing, sleeping, and having fun. One way to have fun is to play a game from the collection of mini-games included. The player can also customize Tom and his home. The original game’s gameplay is enhanced in the sequel through various new features.
Tom has pets of his own, which can interact with Tom and with the player in various ways. There are also toys to interact with, such as a basketball hoop, a trampoline, and a drum kit. The player can tap and poke Tom, as well as pick him up, move him around, and throw him. Tom can also get minor illnesses and injuries, which the player can heal using various cures in Tom’s medicine cabinet.
Unlike in the original game, new items are not unlocked by leveling up. Instead, the player collects fuel for Tom’s plane. When the plane’s fuel tank is full, Tom can fly to one of several themed worlds and return with a selection of new items from that world. Players can now also customize Tom’s plane.
Reception
My Talking Tom 2 has reached over 1 billion downloads and continues to rank one of the top 5 virtual pet category several years after release.According to multiple publications like Business of Apps, Mobilegamer.biz and Gadget Now, the game is one of the most downloaded mobile games globally.
Coverage of My Talking Tom 2 in mobile gaming media highlighted its upgrade of animation, visual style and travel system. Publications such as Pocket Gamer and GamingonPhone noted the game’s emphasis on upgraded graphics and travel system compared to its predecessor.Gamezebo and Common Sence Media report the game is entertaining and suitable for children. Many reviews express concerns about in-game advertisements and gradual progression system. Android Authority listed the game among notable virtual pet titles on Android.
In 2018, the game was nominated for "Best Mobile App of 2018" at the Best Mobile App Awards.''
As of 2026, My Talking Tom 2 holds a user rating of approximately 4.3 out of 5 stars on Google Play and 4.4 out of 5 stars on the Apple App Store.
Collaboration
Between July 13 and August 13, 2023, the game hosted an in-game event to celebrate the 10th anniversary of the My Talking Tom sub-franchise. The celebration also included a collaboration with YouTuber MrBeast and reportedly drew participation from over 49 million users globally. This event featured an exclusive in-game outfit and included a charitable donation to the Tebow CURE Hospital in the Philippines to support surgical care for children.
In November 2024, Rovio Entertainment and Outfit7 launched a cross-franchise crossover event between Angry Birds and Talking Tom & Friends brands. Running from November 7 to November 28, the event featured integrated content across both mobile franchises. In My Talking Tom 2, players could access Angry Birds-themed mini-games and rewards through a dedicated portal. Concurrently, Angry Birds 2 hosted a "chilli-themed" event featuring Talking Tom. The partnership also included the release of two animated shorts depicting characters from both series teaming up against the franchise's antagonists.
